column1: # Self-test cases for scripts/interop.sh, against the baseline fixture.
#   1  id      stable dotted scenario id of results.json; never change it
#   2  state   "ro" (the case does not change the station; servers are shared)
#              "rw" (the case gets a freshly started server)
#   3  exit    expected exit code of the client
#   4  summary expected outcome: ok, error code, confirmations (cause, "n" when
#              negative), termination, and type/cause of every received ASDU
#   5  needs   "-", or features the pairing must declare in print-capabilities,
#              A pairing that lacks one skips the case.
#   6  operation and its flags, as passed to "client"
# Every case runs for every client/server pairing. Besides matching the
# expectation, all pairings must produce the same result document.
